subject.title: feat(gateway): add system.info RPC and Gateway Host card in Settings

question: Should `system.info` expose hostname, LAN address, PID, Node version, and state-dir disk path to every `operator.read` Control UI client, or should some fields require `operator.admin` or be omitted?
rationale: This is a new core protocol method that widens host metadata available to read-scoped clients, and code review cannot infer the intended security/product boundary from tests alone.

options.title: Keep read-scope host card
options.body: Approve the proposed field set under `operator.read`, then fix the old-gateway discovery bug before merge.

options.title: Split sensitive fields
options.body: Keep basic host/resource status under `operator.read` but move path/PID or other sensitive runtime fields behind `operator.admin`.

options.title: Pause the core surface
options.body: Defer the new RPC/card until the existing presence or Instances surface is chosen as the canonical host-identity path.

recommendation.title: Keep read-scope host card
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed field set under `operator.read`, then fix the old-gateway discovery bug before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He sponsored the linked feature request and has the freshest related Settings product history.
